svg.text: E-D Zwei-Bahnen-Küche — the work surface is thrown away
Raw meat and dough are handled between two paper webs: tools act only through the paper; the used paper goes to waste.
module 600 W × 600 D × 450 H
8 actuators; roller and squeegee are passive
paper rolls 400 mm × 200 m · ~18 g per use
nothing in the station is washed per use
SIDE VIEW along the web, 1 px per mm
tool gantry X-Z (dry): press plate, roller, squeegee — they touch only the back of the upper web
lower roll
take-up: used web + scraps → waste
vacuum table, two halves
on 3 load cells
nose bar Ø8
pan (hob)
hinge
cutlet from the opened pack
upper roll
upper take-up
peel bar Ø6 pulls the web back 180°: it peels off the food
press plate 0.5–1.5 kN → 5 mm
roller presses crumbs on at 30 N, through the paper
cutlet lands in the pan,
drop ≤ 30 mm
Frikadellen: patty paper made into a machine
Rouladen: the web is the rolling apron
Cleaning = throwing the surface away

g.text: Per use ≈ 0.6 m lower + 0.5 m upper web = 0.44 m², about 18 g of paper.
40 % of meals: ≈ 2.6 kg paper per year, ≈ 25 EUR, one roll change per year and web.
Replaces ≈ 5 L + 0.4 kWh of washing per use: the gain is certainty, not economy.
Check: a fresh web is clean by definition; camera checks it is whole (no tear).
Paper with raw-meat juice goes into the sealed bin at once (compostable grade).
Cannot cut raw meat on paper; covers flat, sticky work only (~1/5 of operations).

svg.text: 1/7 Raw cutlet slides from its opened pack onto the lower paper web
2/7 Upper web is drawn over it; the press plate flattens the cutlet through the paper
3/7 Peel bar pulls the upper web back on itself: paper peels off, nothing is pulled off the food
4/7 Crumbs on the other half; book flip: the table folds like a book and turns the cutlet onto them
5/7 Upper web over again; the roller presses the crumbs on through the paper
6/7 Lower web advances: the cutlet slides off over the nose bar into the pan, no tool under it
7/7 Used paper and scraps are wound up and thrown away — table and tools never touched food
